page_title: GRA 0-4 RMA | Granada CF v Real Madrid 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
89' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Lucas Boye (Granada CF), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
88' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
86' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
84' Joselu (Real Madrid) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
81' Substitution. Myrto Uzuni leaves the pitch and is replaced by Oscar Melendo (Granada CF).
81' The corner is swung in but Real Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
77' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
76' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) is about to take a corner kick.
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Granada CF comes to nothing. The ball goes out of play. Granada CF are awarded a corner kick.
74' Bruno Mendez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF).
74' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
73' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Augusto Batalla comes off his line to gather the ball.
73' Real Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
73' The attendance is 20058.
71' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
70' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) replaces Antonio Rudiger.
70' Substitution. Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Luka Modric walks off.
69' Granada CF win a corner.
68' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
66' Joselu (Real Madrid) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Augusto Batalla.
63' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) is flagged for offside.

61' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
58' 0 - 4 Fantastic team goal! Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) was set free in the area by Luka Modric and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 0:4.
57' Real Madrid are seeing far more of the ball now.
53' Substitution. Sergio Ruiz walks off the pitch and Martin Hongla (Granada CF) comes on as a substitute.
53' Substitution. Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) on for Gerard Gumbau.

49' 0 - 3 Goal! Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the left post. Augusto Batalla had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:3.
46' Jose Ramon Sandoval makes a switch. Jose Callejon is coming on in place of Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' 0 - 2 Goal! Arda Guler (Real Madrid) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 0:2. He was ably assisted there by Fran Garcia.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes had an easy-decision to make.
42' None of the Granada CF players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
40' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

38' 0 - 1 What a brilliant goal by Fran Garcia (Real Madrid)! He collected a well-executed pass that had put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper. He took the goal-scoring opportunity with a shot to the middle of the goal past the keeper.
35' The resulting corner from Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
33' Real Madrid hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
31' Joselu (Real Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
30' Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
29' Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
29' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle and it's Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

28' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the right side of the goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Augusto Batalla.
27' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
25' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
24' Granada CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
23' A pass from Arda Guler (Real Madrid) is intercepted by Augusto Batalla and the move breaks down.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Madrid.
21' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Corner kick. Real Madrid will have an opportunity.
20' Granada CF fail to score from a corner as Thibaut Courtois (Real Madrid) leaps to collect the ball.

20' Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Thibaut Courtois is prepared and leaps to thwart him. The referee signals a corner kick to Granada CF.
19' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) takes a short corner kick.
19' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF). Granada CF will take a corner kick.
18' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
14' Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
8' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) makes a strong challenge and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul.
7' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
5' Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
4' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Augusto Batalla intercepts the ball.
3' The Real Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Real Madrid will kick-off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes will officiate today.
